replacements.reason: HSD_JObj::mtx is the complete inline 3x4 matrix. Taking the address of its first row produces the same address but makes GCC 11 infer a one-row, 16-byte region for a 48-byte matrix parameter. Passing the array itself uses the declaration-equivalent decay already used by other HSD_MtxGetRotation callers. Exact GALE01 DOL code at 0x802A0DFC adds the HSD_JObj matrix offset 0x44 before the call, so the accessed address, matrix extent, and behavior are unchanged.
